meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 构建或修改网页、终端界面后，Claude 会先渲染界面并截图、比对参考图或预期，再派两个只读审查员分别核查“设计系统与功能”和“视觉保真/CJK 文字”，最后给出通过、返工或失败的整体结论。
howto.when: 在你改动过网页或终端界面，或问“这个页面/组件/TUI 看起来对不对”时接管；也用于截图/像素比对、设计系统检查、CJK 文字截断等视觉类检查。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页，请做一次视觉 QA 并对照参考图。
say.note: Claude 会截屏、比对并给出通过或返工结论。

say.text: 检查这几个组件的样式是否符合设计系统。
say.note: 审查样式是否由通用规则驱动，识别只贴图的情况。

say.text: 检查这个 TUI 的边框对齐和中文是否截断。
say.note: 按终端捕获流程检查对齐与宽字符。

howto.what_en: After any UI build/change, Claude captures screenshots or TUI text, diffs them against reference or intent, runs two read-only reviewer passes (design-system/functional; visual/CJK), and returns one good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any UI, or when asked whether a page/component/TUI looks right; also for screenshot/pixel diff, design-system checks, and CJK text clipping checks.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on the login page against the reference image.
say_en.note: Claude screenshots, diffs, and returns a pass/revise verdict.

say_en.text: Check whether these components match the design system.
say_en.note: Reviews tokens and reuse; flags mock-only screens.

say_en.text: Check this TUI's borders and Chinese text clipping.
say_en.note: Runs terminal capture; checks borders and wide glyphs.
